Title: New habits took about 66 days on average, not 21
Description: Give keys one spot by the door you use and tie it to walking in. Habit research puts automatic at about 66 days, and a missed day won't reset it. A 10-week plan.

Title: Never leave rice in a switched-off rice cooker overnight
Description: Rice left at room temperature can grow a toxin that survives 250°F, so reheating can't save it. The cooling clock, a keep-or-toss table, and the rice-cooker trap.
Keywords: food safety, food storage and leftovers, meal planning and food waste

Title: No home, no room, or no reset? Each needs a different fix
Description: Clutter returns when things lack a home, storage is full, or resets are too far apart. A quick pile audit shows which, plus when it's more than clutter.

Title: Power out? Fridge holds about 4 hours, full freezer 48
Description: Fridge at 40°F by thermometer, food cold within 2 hours, leftovers 3–4 days, reheat to 165°F, plus FDA's power-outage limits and why dates don't decide.
Keywords: food safety, food storage and leftovers

Title: Skip the mold test kit and find the damp spot instead
Description: A musty smell is usually gas from mold growing on something damp. Find it with your nose and a hygrometer, skip the test kit, and size a dehumidifier right.
